environment.description: Same Go binary deployed in a Kubernetes pod on GKE with a custom AppArmor profile 'k8s-myapp-restricted' loaded via annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/myapp=localhost/k8s-myapp-restricted. The profile denies read access to /etc/myapp/secrets/** after process initialization (using aa_change_hat via a wrapper), meaning the api_keys map is populated at startup but the secrets file cannot be re-read at runtime. Pod runs with securityContext.readOnlyRootFilesystem=true. Istio sidecar enforces mTLS with 50ms request-level jitter injection via an EnvoyFilter fault.delay configuration (fixed_delay: 50ms, percentage: 100). Node-level iptables NOTRACK rule disables conntrack for pod CIDR, adding non-deterministic packet scheduling.

config.apparmor_profile: k8s-myapp-restricted (denies /etc/myapp/secrets/** read after init phase via aa_change_hat)
config.rate_limiting: envoy local rate limit 10 req/s per source IP
